{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Even if no commas are visible, we follow the documentation
# and strip any potential commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm parsing worked
print("Example parsed revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not valid for conversion rate)
valid_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print("Number of completed orders:", len(valid_orders))

# Confirm no QA orders (with revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = valid_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders in completed set:", qa_mask.sum())

# Check channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(valid_orders['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(valid_orders['channel'], valid_orders['customer_segment']))"}
